title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty to the model based on the absolute values of the coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the bias of the model?

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model tends to become simpler. What is a possible effect on the model bias?

title: Exploring Model Variance
text: Consider how LASSO regularization, by potentially reducing the number of features, might impact the model's sensitivity to fluctuations in the training data. What could this mean for the model's variance?

title: Effect on Model Variance
text: With LASSO regularization, the model might use fewer features. What is a possible effect on the model variance?

title: Training Data MSE
text: Think about how adding a penalty term in LASSO affects the model's fit to the training data. Does it make the model fit the training data more closely or less closely?

title: Effect on Training Data MSE
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model might not fit the training data as closely. What is a possible effect on the MSE of the training data?

title: Test Data MSE
text: Consider how a simpler model, due to LASSO regularization, might perform on unseen data. Could this lead to a better generalization?

title: Effect on Test Data MSE
text: With LASSO regularization, the model might generalize better to new data. What is a possible effect on the MSE of the test data?
